technical.summary: Mixed short-term bullish technicals (RSI-9, supertrend, hull) conflicted by overbought stochastic conditions, weak trend strength (ADX 10.56), negative money flow, and price below intermediate moving averages—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: TJX shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, imminent earnings in 36 days, and complete absence of government contracts and lobbying activity.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no conviction signal; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (359.68), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, CPI event imminent, and earnings binary 36 days out create compounded downside risk for discretionary consumer stock.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9, supertrend, and hull are bullish with price near support (54.99) in extreme fear environment (32/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 359.68), price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, negative money flow, weak ADX trend strength (10.56), stochastic overbought cross, and high earnings risk in 36 days create compounded downside risk that overwhelms short-term bullish technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: While RSI-9, supertrend, and hull show short-term bullish alignment at support (54.99) in extreme fear environment, macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD) and negative money flow create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary in 36 days combined with VIX in crisis territory (359.68) and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA creates compounded downside risk; weak ADX (10.56) indicates insufficient trend strength to sustain rally.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
